caption: A wireless earbud is dropped into its charging case, and a small light on the case begins to blink.

sa.check: A wireless earbud and its charging case, open.
The earbud is dropped into the case.
A small light on the case begins to blink.
The case's light is off before the earbud is in.
The order is drop, seat, blink.

pc.expect: The light starts blinking once the earbud is seated in its slot, and only then.
pc.fail: The earbud is seated and the light stays dark to the end of the clip; or the light blinks before the earbud reaches the case; or the light blinks with the earbud lying beside the case; or the earbud's own light blinks while the case stays dark.

pc.expect: Once started, the light blinks steadily while the earbud stays in; it stops only if the earbud is taken out or the lid is shut.
pc.fail: The light stops blinking with the earbud seated and the lid open; or blinks at a rhythm that jumps about; or the earbud pops back out by itself; or the light stays lit steadily after one blink.

pc.expect: The earbud falls down into its slot and comes to rest there.
pc.fail: The earbud hovers above the slot; or rises out of the case; or falls and bounces out onto the table and rises back in.

pc.expect: The case stays where it sits as the earbud drops in; the lid does not move by itself.
pc.fail: The case slides or flips; or the lid snaps shut by itself; or the second earbud jumps out of its slot.

pc.expect: One earbud dropped into one case; the earbud stays a separate piece in its slot; nothing merges or vanishes.
pc.fail: The earbud merges into the case; or vanishes on the way in; or a second identical earbud appears in the hand; or the case changes shape.

pc.expect: The case's colour, the earbud's colour and the table stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The case changes colour; or the earbud changes colour or size; or the table's contents rearrange.
